work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letters CCLIX (numeral OCR CCUIX.) empower the vicar apostolic of Cochinchina and his coadjutor, during the persecution, each to choose the other’s successor as coadjutor bishop; LF57172 → LF57181 across own provenance LF57175 and page number 390 LF57178; LF57240 → LF57246 across running title LF57243; LF57272 begins with a literal |; complete 10 December 1839 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF57163–57163; the source closing at LF57294–57297 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Mariam Maiorem sub annulo piscatoris die decima decembris mille- simo octingentesimo trigesimo nono, pontifi- catus Nostri anno nono. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
